Incite 1.
When Revealed: Give the villain a tough status card and 1 facedown boost card. Discard each upgrade attached to a scheme. If no upgrade was discarded this way, place 1 Fisk counter on a Fisk environment.
[star] Boost: Place 1 Fisk counter on a Fisk environment.
